Coach’s note

Grab a foot, lift it, sweep it toward the flag, then let go. Run a test to see what Pip learned.

How to play

  1. Guide a joint.

    Drag a foot in a small upward arc toward the flag. You can also guide a leg, arm, hand, head, back, or belly.

  2. Let go to teach.

    Each gesture trains Pip’s motor memory. A foot lesson also gives the other leg a starting point. Teach either leg again to refine its step.

  3. Run a test.

    Pip tries the course on its own. Between trials it experiments with cadence, reach, and lift, keeping changes that score better.

Keyboard controls

Tab to the training floor. Press J to cycle through joints. Hold Space, move with the arrow keys, then release Space to teach. Enter starts or stops a test.
